task.instruction: Identify a course on Coursera related to 'Artificial Intelligence for Healthcare' and note the course duration along with the number of quizzes in Assessments.

final_answer:
I picked the Coursera course "AI for Healthcare" (offered by AI CERTs, https://www.coursera.org/learn/ai-for-healthcare).

Duration: 1 week to complete, at 10 hours a week. It is a Beginner level course with 9 modules and a flexible schedule.

Assessments: the page lists 8 assignments. It doesn't list any quizzes separately. The Assessments section says "8 assignments", so the number of quizzes is 8 if you count assignments as quizzes.

judge.rationale: The Coursera page supports the chosen course, duration “1 week to complete at 10 hours a week,” and Assessments showing “8 assignments.”
